versions.content: Delegation of PortPrototype s typed by a ParameterIn- terface Access to shared calibration parameters can be provided and required even over CompositionSwComponentType s using DelegationSwConnector s and AssemblySwConnector s. This means that each access to calibration parameters between SwComponentPro- totype s is explicitly visible. If a SwConnector spans after the mapping of SwCom- ponentPrototype s over two different ECUs the system generation process has to ensure the proper allocation of the ParameterDataPrototype while the calibration system has to cope with setting the parameter synchronously on the affected ECUs.
